result: If I could change the world in one way, I would advocate for a global education system that is accessible and sustainable for all. In a world where everyone, regardless of their socioeconomic status, gender, race, or geographic location, has access to high-quality education. Everyone could receive not just an academic education but also understanding the importance of environmental stewardship, mental health, and life-long learning. Equitable education would empower people to live healthier, more fulfilling lives, foster innovation born from diverse perspectives, and cultivate global citizens with the tools to address worldwide issues, thus sparking a cycle of more enlightened and compassionate leaders to build a hopeful, equitable future.
